title: blob.rs: Content-Type truncation panics on multibyte UTF-8 boundary
description: blob_upload_handler truncates Content-Type with &s[..MAX_CONTENT_TYPE_LEN]. This is a byte-index slice on &str; if the 256th byte is a UTF-8 continuation byte the indexing panics. Content-Type values are ASCII by RFC but the path reaches this code after only to_str().ok() validation, which accepts arbitrary non-ASCII bytes. Fix: use s.chars().take(MAX_CONTENT_TYPE_LEN).collect::<String>(), or assert/reject non-ASCII before truncating.
